description: Starts importing the past messages of a connected inbox into Sergio, as Import history on Data sources does: source openphone (Quo) or gmail, or transcripts; days back (default 90). The account must already be connected (connecting is the owner's, in Settings). A second start while one is running returns that job; it carries on in the background. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: start_history_import
title: Import message history from a connected inbox
